answer: Audits are published in kernel, queued in voyage, and beacon publishes the wait time. A farm of 240 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 29 identities per epoch. A farm of 1544 identities would post 2058 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
